title: Isaac and Abimelech

questions.question: Where did Isaac go during the famine?
questions.explanation: Genesis 26:1: Isaac went to Gerar to Abimelech king of the Philistines.

questions.question: What did Isaac say about Rebekah?
questions.explanation: Genesis 26:7: Isaac said Rebekah was his sister.

questions.question: Did God appear to Isaac?
questions.explanation: Genesis 26:2: The LORD appeared to Isaac.

questions.question: What did Isaac do that made him wealthy?
questions.explanation: Genesis 26:12: Isaac sowed in the land and reaped a hundredfold.

questions.question: Did Isaac make peace with Abimelech?
questions.explanation: Genesis 26:28-31: They made a covenant of peace.

questions.question: Why did the Philistines stop up Isaac's wells?
questions.explanation: Genesis 26:14-15: The Philistines envied Isaac and stopped up the wells.

questions.question: What did Isaac name the well where there was no quarreling?
questions.explanation: Genesis 26:22: Isaac named it Rehoboth, saying "the LORD has made room for us."

questions.question: How did Abimelech discover Rebekah was Isaac's wife?
options: He saw Isaac laughing with her
questions.correctAnswer: He saw Isaac laughing with her
questions.explanation: Genesis 26:8: Abimelech saw Isaac laughing with Rebekah.

questions.question: Why did Abimelech ask Isaac to leave?
questions.explanation: Genesis 26:16: "you are much mightier than we."

questions.question: What wells did Isaac reopen?
questions.explanation: Genesis 26:18: Isaac reopened the wells that had been dug in Abraham's days.

questions.question: What was the first well Isaac's servants dug called?
How much did Isaac's crops yield?
questions.explanation: Genesis 26:12: Isaac reaped in that year a hundredfold.

questions.question: Who came with Abimelech to make a covenant with Isaac?
questions.explanation: Genesis 26:26: Abimelech came with Ahuzzath his adviser and Phicol his army commander.

questions.question: What did Isaac call the well at Beersheba?
questions.explanation: Genesis 26:33: He called it Shibah, giving the city its name Beersheba.

questions.question: How old was Esau when he married Hittite women?
questions.explanation: Genesis 26:34: When Esau was 40 years old, he took Hittite wives.

key_verse_text: 'I will multiply your offspring as the stars of heaven and will give to your offspring all these lands.'
